warrior-of-mystic-brews.summary: A monk who fights with a drunkard's lurching sway and brews magic drinks to boost their martial arts.

Bonus Proficiencies.summary: Gain Performance (or another Monk level 1 skill if you have it) and Brewer's Supplies.

Drunken Technique.summary: Spending a Focus Point on Patient Defense gives +10 ft Speed this turn and one Unarmed Strike right after the Bonus Action.

Tipsy Sway.summary: Stand from Prone for 5 ft of movement; and when a foe's melee attack misses you, Reaction and 1 Focus Point to land it on another creature you see within 5 ft.

options.name: Leap to Your Feet
options.summary: Getting up from Prone costs only 5 ft of movement.

options.name: Redirect Attack
options.summary: Reaction and 1 Focus Point when a melee attack misses you: it hits a creature you pick (not the attacker) that you see within 5 ft.

Mystic Brew.summary: Finishing a Short or Long Rest holding Brewer's Supplies, make one pint of a magic drink only you benefit from; drinking takes 1 minute and lasts 1 hour (8 hours for 1 Focus Point) or until another drink. Unused brew vanishes at your next rest.

options.name: Cinnamon Dragon
options.summary: Magic action: 30-ft Cone, DEX save (8 + PB + WIS) for four Martial Arts dice of Fire and Poisoned until its next turn ends; half and no Poisoned on a success.

options.name: Heavenly Spirit
options.summary: Resistance to two of Cold, Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant (your pick).

options.name: Refreshing Dip
options.summary: A pool of Martial Arts dice (WIS + half Monk level); when you regain HP, roll one to heal that much more.

Wizened Brewer.summary: New Mystic Brew drinks: Blue Lightning, Drunkard's Luck and Stumbling Monk.

options.name: Blue Lightning
options.summary: Any Reaction other than an Opportunity Attack or a spell can include one Unarmed Strike.

options.name: Drunkard’s Luck
options.summary: Gain Heroic Inspiration if you lack it, and grant it to yourself when making an ability check or save without it.

options.name: Stumbling Monk
options.summary: After any Bonus Action besides Patient Defense, you may also use Patient Defense at once.

Master Brewer.summary: One Mystic Brew can mix two different drinks, giving both effects for its duration.

Intoxicated Frenzy.summary: After Patient Defense, move up to your Speed; entering a space within 5 ft of a creature lets you Unarmed Strike it (once per creature per turn), and a hit forces a DEX save or Prone.
